text:
aya-support: Hey team — StudioCo reported a failed payment for PO-4521. Customer attempted to pay the invoice with a company card, got a 3DS challenge, then saw 'Authentication failed'. They pasted the UI screenshot and say the bank declined after challenge. :frowning:

payments-bot: Charge 987654321 failed — code=card_declined, decline_reason=authentication_failed, acquirer=acq-eu-1

aya-support: Repro steps from customer: 1) click pay 2) redirect to issuer 3) complete 3DS challenge 4) redirect back -> error page 'Payment could not be completed'. They also tried a different card and that succeeded (personal card).

nick-payments: Can you paste the API logs for the failing attempt? Curious whether we got an auth_required vs issuer decline.

aya-support: Pasted log snippet from our payments API: ```
POST /v1/charges
{ "amount": 50000, "currency": "usd", "source": "card_abc123", "metadata": { "invoice": "INV-2026-233" } }

Response 402:
{ "error": { "type": "card_error", "code": "card_declined", "decline_code": "authentication_required", "message": "Authentication failed at issuer" } }
```

samir-eng: Quick thought: decline_code="authentication_required" usually means 3DS was required but the ACS returned failure. Need full acquirer flow logs (PAReq/PARes or EMV 3DS responses). Aya can you attach the gateway/acquirer trace (gateway_request_id)?

aya-support: Gateway trace id: gw_0a9c3f. I asked the customer and they supplied the issuer reference: ACS_REF=ACS12345. Sending to Nick and Samir.

nick-payments: Thanks. I'll check acquirer logs. Two quick angles: (1) was this card on a corporate account with PO? PO shouldn't affect auth but some corporate cards route to corporate ACS that blocks 3DS flows. (2) Are we doing acquirer fallback? If primary acquirer returned an auth failure we may be able to retry through fallback in 30s per policy.

laura-am: FYI this is a mid-market customer doing a monthly invoice flow. They are sensitive to failed invoices since they have billing automation. They're asking whether we can retry automatically or if we need them to re-add the card.

ingrid-sre: @nick-payments please confirm if retrying will count as a duplicate charge in our ledger. We need idempotency handled.

nick-payments: We use idempotency keys tied to charge_attempt_id so a fresh retry with same payment_method will create a new attempt but link to same invoice. I'll coordinate with Samir on safe retry logic.

samir-eng: From runtime side, can we surface more granular decline codes in the console? Right now UI shows 'Authentication failed' which is unhelpful. We should show 'ACS returned failed auth' and acquirer. I'll open a small task but meanwhile we can respond to customer with instructions.

aya-support: Sent customer suggested steps: 1) Try corporate card again from private window 2) If still fails, ask their card admin to confirm corporate ACS won't block 3DS challenges 3) Provide a fallback payment (we accepted their personal card before). They've asked whether we can retry ourselves.

nick-payments: I'm seeing acquirer trace: acq-eu-1 -> ACS responded with E3 status (3DSv2: technical failure) then acquirer returned authentication_failed. No fallback attempt was triggered because the gateway returned a hard decline. We can attempt a graceful retry to a secondary acquirer (acq-global-2) but need signoff from eng and ops for potential increase in latency and duplicate attempts.

ingrid-sre: Approve retry to fallback acquirer for a single on-demand support-initiated retry. We'll monitor for duplicate reconciliation issues.

laura-am: Customer wants us to retry once. I'll message them that we will attempt one support-initiated retry and report back within 10 minutes.

aya-support: Going to trigger manual retry now with fallback acquirer. Using idempotency key "support-retry-1945678901-1". Pasting command: ```
POST /internal/payments/retry
{ "charge_id": "987654321", "target_acquirer": "acq-global-2", "idempotency_key": "support-retry-1945678901-1" }
```

payments-bot: Support retry initiated by aya-support — retry_id=retry_7722, target_acquirer=acq-global-2

payments-bot: Retry result — status=failed, decline_code=insufficient_funds, acquirer=acq-global-2

aya-support: Customer replied: tried again and got 'insufficient funds' on corporate card. They say their accounting team confirmed there were sufficient funds — looks inconsistent across issuers.

nick-payments: Mixed decline reasons across acquirers (authentication_required vs insufficient_funds) suggests issuer-side rate-limits or an authorization hold. Ask customer to check with their bank; ask for exact time and 6-digit ACS_REF. We have acquirer traces.

samir-eng: I'll flag this in the payments service: add a diagnostic line combining decline_codes across acquirers and show to support. Also add note to console: "If auth failure then fallback may still be declined for other reasons — coordinate with customer bank."

laura-am: I'll let the customer know we escalated and provide two options: (A) Have accounting use alternative card or (B) ask their bank to whitelist the 3DS flow and retry.

aya-support: Customer accepted option A for now (they used ACH fallback). Marking thread resolved from support side but keeping open for engineering follow-up on better UI/error mapping. :white_check_mark:

samir-eng: Filing ENG ticket to improve error mapping and add a short-runbook for support retries: ENG-PI-2319.

nick-payments: Noted. I'll follow up if we see recurring cases for PO customers routing to corporate ACS.

aya-support: Thanks everyone. Closing on StudioCo case.
